$description: D&D 5e 2024 class resources (Rage, Ki, Wild Shape, etc.)

data.name: Rage
data.description: Enter a rage as a Bonus Action, gaining benefits for 10 rounds or until incapacitated.

data.name: Bardic Inspiration
data.description: As a Bonus Action, give an ally a Bardic Inspiration die (d6 to d12 based on level).

data.name: Channel Divinity
data.description: Channel divine energy through your holy symbol to fuel magical effects (2 uses at Lv 2, 3 at Lv 6, 4 at Lv 18; regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long Rest).

data.name: Wild Shape
data.description: Magically transform into a beast you have seen (2 uses at Lv 2, 3 at Lv 6, 4 at Lv 17; regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long Rest).

data.name: Action Surge
data.description: Take one additional action on your turn.

data.name: Second Wind
data.description: As a Bonus Action, regain HP equal to 1d10 + your Fighter level (2 uses at Lv 1, 3 at Lv 4, 4 at Lv 10; regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long Rest).

data.name: Indomitable
data.description: Reroll a failed saving throw with a bonus equal to your Fighter level (1 use at Lv 9, 2 at Lv 13, 3 at Lv 17).

data.name: Superiority Dice
data.description: Fuel Battle Master combat maneuvers (4 dice at Lv 3, 5 at Lv 7, 6 at Lv 15; d8 -> d10 at Lv 10 -> d12 at Lv 18).

data.name: Ki Points
data.description: Harness the mystic energy of Focus/Ki to fuel special Monk abilities.

data.name: Uncanny Metabolism
data.description: Once per Long Rest when you roll Initiative, regain all expended Focus/Ki points and heal 1 Martial Arts die + Monk level HP.

data.name: Channel Divinity
data.description: Channel divine energy to fuel magical effects granted by your oath (2 uses at Lv 3, 3 at Lv 11; regain 1 on Short Rest, all on Long Rest).

data.name: Lay on Hands
data.description: A pool of healing power that can restore HP or cure Poisoned/conditions.

data.name: Favored Enemy (Hunter's Mark)
data.description: Cast Hunter's Mark without expending a spell slot (2 free casts at Lv 1, 3 at Lv 5, 4 at Lv 9, 5 at Lv 13, 6 at Lv 17).

data.name: Innate Sorcery
data.description: Bonus Action (1 min): +1 to Sorcerer spell save DC and Advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls.

data.name: Sorcery Points
data.description: A pool of magical energy used for Metamagic and spell slot conversion.

data.name: Magical Cunning
data.description: Perform a 1-minute esoteric rite once per Long Rest to regain expended Pact Magic spell slots up to half your maximum (rounded up).

data.name: Arcane Recovery
data.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover spell slots with combined level up to half your wizard level (rounded up).

data.name: Psionic Energy Dice (Psi Warrior)
data.description: Fuel Psionic Power abilities. Regain 1 expended die on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

data.name: Psionic Energy Dice (Soulknife)
data.description: Fuel Psi-Bolstered Knack and Psychic Whispers. Regain 1 die on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

data.name: Warding Flare
data.description: Reaction: Impose Disadvantage on an attack roll made by a creature within 30 feet. (Recharges on Short Rest at Lv 6+)

data.name: War Priest
data.description: Bonus Action: Make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike.

data.name: Steps of the Fey
data.description: Cast Misty Step without expending a spell slot and trigger a Fey effect.

data.name: Healing Light (d6 Pool)
data.description: Bonus Action: Spend d6s (up to CHA mod at once) to heal a creature within 60 feet. Pool equals 1 + Warlock level.

data.name: Star Map (Free Guiding Bolt)
data.description: Cast Guiding Bolt without expending a spell slot (WIS modifier uses per Long Rest).

data.name: Sorcerous Restoration
data.description: On a Short Rest, regain Sorcery Points equal to half your Sorcerer level (round down). Once per Long Rest.

data.name: Stroke of Luck
data.description: Turn a failed D20 Test into a natural 20. Recharges on a Short or Long Rest.

data.name: Breath Weapon (Dragonborn)
data.description: Replace one attack to exhale elemental energy (15-ft Cone or 30-ft Line, DEX save DC 8 + CON + PB). Uses = Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

data.name: Giant Ancestry (Goliath)
data.description: Activate your supernatural Giant Ancestry boon (Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, or Storm). Uses = Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

data.name: Adrenaline Rush (Orc)
data.description: Bonus Action: Take the Dash action and gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses = Proficiency Bonus per Short or Long Rest.

data.name: Healing Hands (Aasimar)
data.description: Magic Action: Touch a creature and roll d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus to restore Hit Points. Once per Long Rest.

data.name: Celestial Revelation (Aasimar)
data.description: 2024 PHB: Bonus Action at Lv 3+ to choose Heavenly Wings, Inner Radiance, or Necrotic Shroud for 1 minute (+PB extra Radiant/Necrotic damage 1/turn).

data.name: Luck Points (Lucky Feat)
data.description: 2024 PHB: Spend 1 Luck Point to give yourself Advantage on a D20 Test or impose Disadvantage on an attack roll against you. Pool = Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
